evidence: RESOLVED: Round-1 MINOR on concept-ID length parity. _concept_list now requires palimnex.concepts MIN_CONCEPT_ID_CHARS=3 and MAX_CONCEPT_ID_CHARS=128 plus _CONCEPT_ID_RE.fullmatch. Independent rehashed documents: length 2 (ab) and 129 (a*129) are rejected by both validate_shadow_comparison (invalid_concept_id) and Draft 2020-12 via a local referencing.Registry; length 3 (abc, a-b) and 128 (a*128) are accepted by both. Schema and docs SHA-256 are unchanged from round 1.

NOTE: Empty string and 128-character pattern violations (trailing separator, uppercase, leading digit, consecutive separators, trailing space) are rejected by both runtime and schema. Comparison $defs.conceptId equals registry $defs.conceptId. palimnex.tests.test_ontology_shadow covers the 2/3/128/129 length cases.

NOTE: Unsorted concept-id lists fail runtime as ordering_or_duplicate and pass JSON Schema. The fix brief required keeping this stricter cross-field rule; ontology_shadow.py comments that JSON Schema cannot express lexicographic array ordering.
source_grounding_result: Channel ranking still uses match_aliases and verify_source_bindings. A chunk qualifies when a contributing approved concept has a verified repo binding whose inclusive line range overlaps the chunk. Byte ranges convert from current file bytes; empty byte ranges overlap no chunk. Non-repo verified bindings can establish contribution and do not map to repository chunks. Fix-round-1 changed only concept-ID length enforcement in the comparison validator.
privacy_result: Query and source privacy admission still run before derivation. Focused tests cover secret-query and R7 symlink refusals. Independent shadow_retrieve probes show the comparison document omits raw query text; baseline.query remains the retrieve_sources field.
retrieval_quality_result: Score remains distinct contributing concepts overlapping a chunk, sorted by descending score then ascending pointer, capped at 512 with truncated disclosure. Candidate registries never rank. Ambiguous, stale, and uncovered concepts never contribute. evaluate-ontology-shadow gates all passed, including no_critical_regression, abstention_not_regressed, and ambiguity_never_contributes.
compatibility_result: Adds palimnex:ontology-shadow-comparison:v1, OntologyChannel, ontology_channel, build_shadow_comparison, and validate_shadow_comparison. Runtime concept-ID bounds now match schema $defs.conceptId (3-128) and palimnex.concepts constants. The runtime remains stricter on lexicographic list ordering, as required by the fix brief. Existing retrieval identifiers and evaluate-ontology-shadow gate results are unchanged.
rollback_result: Delete palimnex/ontology_shadow.py, palimnex/tests/test_ontology_shadow.py, palimnex/schemas/ontology-shadow-comparison.v1.schema.json, and docs/ONTOLOGY_SHADOW.md, and revert the channel implementation receipt. palimnex/retrieval.py imports this module, so rollback of the channel files alone requires a matching retrieval-lane revert.
authority_result: Every comparison hard-codes retrieval_influence false, returned_ranking_changed false, authority evidence_only, and authorizes_actions false. Independent shadow_retrieve and evaluate-ontology-shadow runs confirmed those flags. No approved product registry is created. Reviewer performed no Git writes, network calls, or live-state mutation.
limitations: Length and pattern probes used rehashed comparison documents; the builder emits only concept-registry IDs that already satisfy 3-128.
Unsorted concept-id lists remain a runtime-only cross-field rule, as required by the fix brief.
